design_philosophy: Corporate Authority with Warmth. The design merges the trust and stability of Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) with the approachability needed for a recruitment firm bridging Singapore and India. Strong, structural layouts using Navy Blue (#0B1F4D) anchor the brand, while Crimson Red (#C8102E) serves as the catalyst for action. We prioritize high-contrast legibility, generous negative space, and real-world photography to build immediate credibility.

layout_strategies.navigation: Sticky crystal glass header (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with 1px bottom border. Logo on left, nav links center (desktop), CTAs right. Red highlight for active state.
layout_strategies.hero: Split layout or image-heavy with strong typography. Overlay opacity max bg-black/40 to let imagery breathe. Bold white heading over dark image or navy heading on light background.
layout_strategies.bento_grid: Used for 'Services' and 'Industries'. Mix tall (row-span-2) and wide (col-span-2) cards. Sharp corners, subtle 1px borders.
layout_strategies.footer: Deep Navy (#0B1F4D) background, white text. Large typography for 'Let's Talk'. Organized columns for links, dual addresses (SG & India).

home.hero: Tagline: 'Right Talent. Right Time. Right Place.' Large Chivo heading. Dual CTAs (Employers / Job Seekers). Background image of Singapore skyline or construction.
home.about: Section highlighting dual presence (Singapore HQ, India sourcing). Trust metrics (years, placements).
home.services: Bento grid of services (Recruitment, Visa, Ticketing, Interviews).
home.industries: Visual gallery of blue-collar job categories with hover reveal effects.
home.process: Horizontal or vertical timeline showing the flow: Requirement -> Sourcing -> Interview -> Visa -> Ticketing -> Deployment.

forms.job_seeker: Clean, linear form flow. Upload resume field. Uses custom Shadcn inputs styled with sharp borders.
forms.employer: Structured inquiry form. Dropdown for 'Trade Needed', number input for 'Number of Workers'.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Navy). Main content area (Light Gray).
admin_dashboard.table: Dense data table for candidate applications and employer inquiries. Status badges (Pending, Contacted). Export button.

images.description: Singapore skyline for establishing local presence and corporate scale.
Construction workers focusing on job, showing real blue-collar work.
Worker with helmet for process step.

interactions.hover: Elements lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow. CTAs transition colors smoothly.
interactions.scroll: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Use intersection observer for triggering animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Navy Blue is the dominant structural color, Red is the accent/CTA color.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Chivo' or similar strong geometric sans-serif for headings, and 'Manrope' for body text.
Ensure all images have an overlay (bg-black/30 to 40) if text is placed on top of them to guarantee APCA contrast compliance.
All interactive elements (buttons, forms, links) MUST have data-testid attributes.
Implement sharp corners (rounded-none) for a more authoritative, Swiss-brutalist corporate feel.
The admin dashboard should use a dense 'Control Room' grid layout for data tables.
Use standard Shadcn components for forms, but override their border-radius to 'rounded-none' to match the brand style.
